'''Tom Colarocco''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 New York State Championship]] on 19 May 2001 with ISB space, according to Josh Paterniti's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2349">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-21-new-york-state-championships-5-19-01d2349/ new-york-state-championships-5-19-01], DeckTech (Josh "Jizosh003" Paterniti, 21 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-21-new-york-state-championships-5-19-01d2349/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
